MATERIAL / WORKSHOP STUDY

02 / MATERIAL MATTERS

Every grain has a story.

We work with solid wood because it carries time beautifully. Texture, tone and small variations make every piece its own. Finished carefully, it can be repaired, refreshed and lived with for years.

01   OAK — BRIGHT, OPEN GRAIN02   WALNUT — RICH, DEEP TONE03   ASH — LIGHT, LIVELY CHARACTER
